exact: core RNA polymerase II recruiting transcription factor activity
related: transcription factor activity, core RNA polymerase II recruiting

definition: Binding to an RNA polymerase II (Pol II) complex, typically composed of twelve subunits, and with another protein, macromolecule, or complex, permitting those molecules to function in a coordinated way in order to facilitate the aggregation, arrangement and bonding together of proteins on an RNA polymerase II promoter DNA to form the transcriptional preinitiation complex (PIC), the formation of which is a prerequisite for transcription by RNA polymerase.
label: RNA polymerase II complex recruiting activity
